risks.title: Export Controls and Trade Tariff Risks
risks.score_rationale: U.S. export restrictions on EDA technologies to China and announced tariffs by the Trump administration could reduce revenue in China and disrupt the global supply chain. The company has already experienced reduced revenue in China due to licensing restrictions between May and July 2025.

risks.title: Dependence on Semiconductor and Electronics Industries
risks.score_rationale: The company's growth is primarily driven by the semiconductor and electronic systems industries. Global economic uncertainty and instability in international relations could reduce booking levels and revenue.

risks.title: Timing and Revenue Recognition
risks.score_rationale: Operating results vary based on the timing of revenue recognition, particularly for hardware, IP, and certain software products. Product mix across periods affects comparability.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company regularly completes acquisitions (3 in fiscal 2025 plus the Hexagon agreement). These acquisitions may fail to deliver expected benefits, cause shareholder value dilution, or disrupt operations.

risks.title: Intellectual Property Protection
risks.score_rationale: The company's success heavily depends on legal protection of its proprietary technologies and licensed intellectual property rights. Infringement or misappropriation could cause significant harm.

risks.title: Prior Export Control Violations and Compliance Obligations
risks.score_rationale: The company entered into a settlement with BIS and the DOJ on July 27, 2025, regarding export control violations between 2015 and 2021 involving $45.3 million in sales to a customer in China. The settlement imposes ongoing audit and compliance obligations.

risks.title: Increased Competition in Electronic Design Industry
risks.score_rationale: The electronic design software industry is highly competitive. New entrants or technological advances could reduce market share and revenue.

ai_positioning.summary: Cadence positions AI as central to its strategy. The company develops AI-driven computational software, accelerated hardware, and intellectual property solutions for chip design. Generative AI, agentive AI, machine learning, and digital twin algorithms are integrated into core products.
evidence: Development of AI-driven computational software and accelerated hardware solutions
